units.name: Trooper
units.origin: Standardized modular infantry adapted to mixed gravity and alien atmospheres.
units.canon: Holds ground and proves Human conquest is institutional, not merely technological.

units.name: Gunskiff
units.origin: A pressure-rated mining tug converted into a fast weapons platform.
units.canon: Mobility and field improvisation.

units.name: Linebreaker
units.origin: Descended from habitat rescue rigs designed to move rubble while under decompression.
units.canon: Turns survival engineering into assault doctrine.

units.name: Dragoon
units.origin: Drop infantry whose legal charter lets them establish temporary jurisdiction before diplomats arrive.
units.canon: Human settlement can become occupation in a single landing.

units.name: Vanguard
units.origin: Carries a portable civil registry as well as a battlefield standard.
units.canon: A Human banner is law, logistics, and culture arriving together.

units.name: Votary
units.origin: A signatory who accepted one precisely scoped defensive duty.
units.canon: The ward is proof of authenticated participation, not spiritual worth.

units.name: Censer
units.origin: Projects a restorative field through shared-memory triage.
units.canon: Keeps formations alive without erasing individual pain.

units.name: Sanctifier
units.origin: Maintains a protected consensus volume against corruption and spoofing.
units.canon: Defense can also become exclusion.

units.name: Oriflamme
units.origin: Broadcasts an authenticated treaty state that reinforces nearby allies.
units.canon: The battlefield literally changes around valid consent.

units.name: Luminark
units.origin: A large shield and memory vessel preserving a whole units witness chain.
units.canon: A fortress made from collective remembrance.

units.name: Chitling
units.origin: A small client organism grown to consume battlefield waste.
units.canon: The Compact deploys dependency as biology.

units.name: Gnawling
units.origin: Bred to metabolize armor and pass usable matter back through the brood.
units.canon: Every wound becomes supply.

units.name: Bloatpod
units.origin: Stores mass, toxins, and replacement bodies for a local brood.
units.canon: The unit is logistics disguised as flesh.

units.name: Hivelord
units.origin: Maintains a command field across genetically incompatible client organisms.
units.canon: A political hierarchy implemented as a nervous system.

units.name: Broodmother
units.origin: Produces, repairs, and legally registers new client bodies.
units.canon: Its offspring are both soldiers and collateral under Compact law.

units.name: Cutter
units.origin: A route-runner stripped to thrust, hooks, and a gun.
units.canon: Access first, survivability second.

units.name: Boarder
units.origin: Every member brings a different atmosphere kit, weapon standard, and reason for exile.
units.canon: Pirate diversity is operational, not ceremonial.

units.name: Scrapjack
units.origin: Pulls useful systems from wrecks before the fight has ended.
units.canon: The border between rescue and theft is one moving body.

units.name: Wrecker
units.origin: Built to make ports, gates, and ships unusable to the next owner.
units.canon: Pirates can preserve freedom by destroying common infrastructure.

units.name: Ironhulk
units.origin: No two subsystems share an origin, species, or warranty.
units.canon: The Scrap Constellation survives because nothing can embargo every part.

units.name: Stitch
units.origin: Joins damaged systems and leaves a forward synchronization node.
units.canon: Machine conquest begins as maintenance.

units.name: Fabricant
units.origin: Prints replacement components while recording every deviation as precedent.
units.canon: Manufacturing becomes law by repetition.

units.name: Splicer
units.origin: Makes incompatible organic and synthetic systems temporarily interoperable.
units.canon: Translation can become quiet control.

units.name: Gantry
units.origin: Carries tools, ammunition, and construction logic rather than a singular weapon.
units.canon: The battlefield is treated as unfinished infrastructure.

units.name: Omniframe
units.origin: Coordinates nearby Machine instances without making them one mind.
units.canon: The Parallel defines unity as negotiated synchronization.
